build_gtn_python_package: build the gtn python package with cmake and setuptools for automatic differentiation with WFSTs
build_cmake_extension: build a cmake extension module like gtn._graph or gtn._autograd using the CMakeExtension class
configure_cmake_build: configure the cmake build with python bindings enabled and examples benchmarks and tests disabled
review_cmakebuild_class: review the CMakeBuild class that validates cmake version and builds c++ extensions via cmake
review_cmakextension_class: review the CMakeExtension class that wraps setuptools Extension for cmake-based c++ modules
